environment: Python 3.14.7, Node test runner, gh shim from the testkit stub-server on PATH, scratch git repo per case

cases.title: Refusals: given flag, given config, negated, regex, two rules never derive
cases.given: a gh shim returns the named rule for every sample; no forge write is possible
cases.when: preflight runs with the attack input
cases.then: the verdict holds the spec guarantee and nothing changes
cases.expected: derived false, original format, exit 1, tree and gh calls read-only
cases.actual: 7 refusals held; stderr empty; treeUnchanged true

cases.title: Unknown kind, null kind, zero rules, empty pattern, mr and direct mode never derive
cases.given: a gh shim returns the named rule for every sample; no forge write is possible
cases.when: preflight runs with the attack input
cases.then: the verdict holds the spec guarantee and nothing changes
cases.actual: held for all; mr and direct keep the original format

cases.title: Failed derivation across 44 affixes x 3 operators keeps first verdict and suggests the derived format
cases.given: a gh shim returns the named rule for every sample; no forge write is possible
cases.when: preflight runs with the attack input
cases.then: the verdict holds the spec guarantee and nothing changes
cases.expected: exit 1 (never 2), format sdlc/{name}, suggestion equals --branch-format line with derived format, samples start with sdlc/ and fail, rules unchanged
cases.actual: held for every failing affix, including .lock, a..b, space, tilde, caret, colon, trailing dot, newline, tab, DEL

cases.title: A derived format printed with ok true must pass validate_format
cases.given: a gh shim returns the named rule for every sample; no forge write is possible
cases.when: preflight runs with the attack input
cases.then: the verdict holds the spec guarantee and nothing changes
cases.expected: every ok true derived format passes validate_format
cases.actual: 21 derived formats print ok true, derived true, exit 0 yet validate_format refuses them (exit 2 from `branches.py name --format`). Examples: starts_with '{' gives '{sdlc/{name}'; ends_with '}' gives 'sdlc/{name}}'; starts_with NBSP, U+0085 or U+3000 gives a format with whitespace.
cases.specSource: R-042 acceptance (ok true with fmt2 that all samples pass); spec section 2 validate_format (no brace outside placeholder, no whitespace); spec section 4 step 1 and edge case 'validate_format rejects the format at pre-flight'; plan risk 'a wrong derivation writes a format the rule rejects'

evidence.title: derived format then name
evidence.inline:
preflight: rule starts_with '{' -> ok true derived true format '{sdlc/{name}' exit 0
branches.py name --format '{sdlc/{name}' --kind slice --id S-001
-> {"ok": false, "error": "the branch format '{sdlc/{name}' holds a brace outside its placeholder"} exit 2

cases.title: Regex literals across 38 patterns in pr and stack mode: literal accepted at S-001 or text fallback, pattern quoted
cases.given: a gh shim returns the named rule for every sample; no forge write is possible
cases.when: preflight runs with the attack input
cases.then: the verdict holds the spec guarantee and nothing changes
cases.expected: substituting S-001 gives a name the pattern accepts
cases.actual: held for every pattern that gave a literal; patterns with no fit (^[a-z]+$, lookahead, backreference, ^$) gave the text fallback with the pattern quoted

cases.title: Invalid, deeply nested (40000), 100k literal, 5000 alternation and catastrophic patterns
cases.given: a gh shim returns the named rule for every sample; no forge write is possible
cases.when: preflight runs with the attack input
cases.then: the verdict holds the spec guarantee and nothing changes
cases.expected: JSON verdict, exit 0 or 1, no traceback, under 20 seconds
cases.specSource: R-122 acceptance; spec section 3 bad regex gives unevaluated

cases.title: Hostile corpus (injection, control-chars, flag-like, format-strings, oversized, traversal, confusables, whitespace, nul) in pattern, label, --branch, --format and config
cases.given: a gh shim returns the named rule for every sample; no forge write is possible
cases.when: preflight runs with the attack input
cases.then: the verdict holds the spec guarantee and nothing changes
cases.expected: exit 0, 1 or 2, JSON, no traceback, stderr empty, no derivation from a given format or in mr mode

seeds.title: suggestion line embeds rule text unescaped
seeds.detail: A pattern or affix with a newline gives a multi-line suggestion that can start a second --branch-format line. A quote or $(id) in a derived affix or regex literal is printed raw inside double quotes, so a pasted line runs a command. Rule text comes from the repo admin's forge settings, a trusted party. Quote with shlex or JSON-escape the value, and keep to one line.

seeds.title: non-string rule pattern crashes preflight with a traceback
seeds.detail: A GitHub rule whose pattern is null, a list, a number or a dict raises TypeError in evaluate (startswith, endswith, in). Exit is 1 with no JSON. The crash is in S-015 code. Treat a non-string pattern as an unevaluated rule with a note.

seeds.title: verify-limits: regex literal builder expands repeat counts in memory
seeds.detail: _shortest multiplies the inner string by the minimum repeat count. A 35 byte pattern uses 4 GB to 10 GB. The spec states no limit. Cap the built length and return None above it.

seeds.title: FutureWarning on stderr for a regex with a nested set
seeds.detail: The pattern ^[[:alpha:]]+/ makes re._parser warn 'Possible nested set' on stderr. It is not a traceback. Suppress warnings around the parse.
